MnNb2Ru is better but its scalar magnetic matching is not certified; retained as contrary source observation, not erased. Tc radioactivity and Ru/Tc channel competition remain risks.

proposed_contribution.intervention: Ta-to-Nb role replacement in cubic Nb2TcRu. coupled chemistry/site-role/volume/mass construction, not isolated geometry or inferred W/n
proposed_contribution.next_action: Bind Nb/Ta site EPC/orbital evidence on same frozen geometry roles. Favorable: Ta-to-Nb paired gain remains with valid channel matching; adverse: relevant competition cancels it; ambiguous: only electron counts or unmatched Mn control available.
proposed_contribution.falsifier: Reproduce the stated target and control with matched pseudopotential family, functional, cutoff, sampling and relevant spin/SOC treatment. Loss or reversal of the claimed response, instability of the target, or an unresolved competing phase changes the decision; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved.
proposed_contribution.new_state_inheritance: A child structure or modification needs its own calculation and identity. It does not inherit source Tc or experimental status.
